headline: RPSG Ventures responds to market rumours
hook: RPSG Ventures addresses recent market speculation
summary: RPSG Ventures Limited has issued a clarification to the NSE regarding recent market rumours under Regulation 30(11) of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The company is required to confirm or deny the veracity of reports circulating in the media. This filing serves as a standard compliance procedure to ensure transparency for shareholders. Retail investors should check the specific disclosure on the NSE website to understand the company's stance on the circulating news.
why_it_matters: Clarification helps investors assess if stock volatility is based on facts.
